title: Wear app: Double-tab settings crash when scrolling down to end
symptom: On the Samsung Galaxy Watch4, double-tapping the watch face to open settings and scrolling down beyond 'Show Loop Status' causes the config page to crash back to the watch face.
fix: Uninstall the wear app and install it again. The user reported that uninstalling/reinstalling twice stopped the crashing temporarily, but it later recurred.
evidence_quote: uninstall wear app and install again
